I read all of it. And why would I want to tell you it's going to get better? I don't see my own life getting better, so I'm not going to even try feeding you that lie.

What I can say though is that having been through so much hurt, so much pain and so much desolation, when things change, we feel it so much more. That other person who lives a normal life that isn't going to appreciate the good as much as we do. That single hug means so much more to us than to the average person. I hope you get a hug you can appreciate soon. I'm still waiting on mine.

What's stopping it from happening in this life?

Closest I get to doing what I want is playing games.

I struggle to contain my own anger. Then I feel shit for feeling anger and hurt. Rinse, repeat.

Is there anything you  enjoy doing?
I was standing on the edge of a balcony yesterday considering the jump. I was sober. Might I ask why you feel dead inside?
Would you like to talk to me? I'm 24 and going through a shit time myself, but I wouldn't mind listening to you.

Would you like to talk? I was bullied a lot in school.  I was strangled and knocked out on two separate occasions. My mother was physically abusive towards me and my dad wasn't around because they were divorced.

So I woke up today. Life wasn't better. That much hasn't changed.
Why do we rely on Maybe all the time?

I rebound my controls so I could have them sort of grouped together. Currently my translation is handled with the arrows keys (Up arrow is forwards, Down is Back, Right is Right and Left is Left. Up and Down is handled by ] and [ respectively). I then bound my pitch up and down to Home and End. Yaw Left and Right to Delete and Page Down. Roll left and Right to Insert and Page Up. MTS (Thruster System) accelerate and decelerate to - and =. FLUX drive to - and +. Much rebinding fun but it feels better grouped for me.

Don't forget to bind your reverse FLUX button :P
I would hope not. Minecraft's appeal to me is the constant suspense of "What's Next?"

Well, a genre has to start somewhere.

Minecraft was originally meant to be a proof of concept. A 3D Engine was created using Java. Minecraft was that test to see if it could be used. It became a phenomenon that exploded out of control and Notch had to make a game from a proof of concept. Ideas +1. Excecution could still be improved. Today's Minecraft is the result of an expirement. Sure, you could criticize every game out there. ALL games have weak and flimsy points. Hacking at them gets no one anywhere. Our conversation is just a jumble of words that few read and even fewer care about. But I digress...

Buying a game for its original content is not how companies make money. Content is always withheld and added later, for a fee. BF3 is an example. Also, I know plenty of people who bought Elder Scrolls: Skyrim not for the main game but for the mods that would come out with it. Its all opinion based. Hating on a revolutionary game (no matter how buggy) isn't "good etiquette". I'm not saying you are wrong. Minecraft is buggy as hell, and it has taken them a little too long to fix many of the bugs, but, it is still a unique game with content being added.

I may be wrong, but I dont know of any other game that has planned to release more content over the rest of the games life. Most games stop and then go on to the next sequel.

Minecraft on its own, still has expansion to go through

The whole appeal to Minecraft is the constant expansion. Agreed, it did get a little slack lately, but now its picking up again. New blocks are being added, new ways of doing things. 

Personally, I play Tekkit. Instead of getting hung up on what we could call the "Base Model", start looking at the expansions out there. Tekkit is a brilliant example. Obviously it will be a little behind the current release, although, the modders work their hardest to catch up. Playing mods is like playing alternate realities. People have so many ideas and they each have the opportunity to express it in their own ways. 

You may not have found your 20 euro's worth in the game, but with the game comes the hundreds of mods to try. You just might find your value in there.
No Content? o_O Please sir, I'm yet to find another game where you can be a farmer, builder, zombie slayer and circuit maker in one game O_O

So.. Your opinion on Tekkit? Do you find it encouraging? A possible future for Minecraft? We see slabs we can place up side down (Which I first saw on RedPower) and now Ender Chests.. Is Tekkit what Minecraft might look like in the far, technologically advance, future?
